verdict.description: approve = safe to ship as-is; changes_required = at least one finding must be addressed first.

summary.description: One short paragraph: what was reviewed and the overall judgment.

findings.description: When approving, only minor findings (or none) are allowed. Each entry is an actionable defect, not a style preference.

problem.description: What is wrong and why it matters.

required_change.description: The concrete change that resolves it.
